parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5-5', max_tokens: 1200, system: "You read one email sent to a dental supply distributor's shared inbox. Classify it as purchase_order, quote_request, support, order_status, invoice, payment_change or other, give a confidence from 0 to 1, extract the fields for that type exactly as written (never guess prices or dates), and draft a short, friendly reply that uses only facts in the email. Never offer discounts or promise delivery dates.", output_config: { effort: 'low', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["type", "confidence", "summary", "fields", "reply"], "properties": {"type": {"enum": ["purchase_order", "quote_request", "support", "order_status", "invoice", "payment_change", "other"]}, "confidence": {"type": "number"}, "summary": {"type": "string"}, "fields": {"type": "object"}, "reply": {"type": ["string", "null"]}}} } }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'From: ' + $json.from + '
Subject: ' + $json.subject + '

' + $json.text + $json.attachments.map(a => '

[Attachment ' + a.name + ']
' + a.text).join('') }] }) }}
